title: carex folliculata var. xanthophysa
intro: Carex folliculata var. xanthophysa, commonly known as a type of sedge, is a plant species within the Carex genus. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Carex folliculata var. xanthophysa are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms associated with colds and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may provide benefits for the cardiovascular and respiratory systems.
